title: Residue-lisse refinement on qcqs weakly etale objects of an affine open-closed tree
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $X$ any scheme. Let $K,L$ be integral constructible complexes of completed integral $E$-coefficient sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Each affine open $U$ admits a finite qcqs open-closed tree [def-sfb-qcqs-open-closed-tree] such that, on every qcqs weakly etale object $V$ of each nonempty leaf $S$, the ordinary uncompleted derived pullback [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback] of either input along $V\to S\to U\to X$ is complete. For each input and object there are integers $a\le b$ such that the exponent-one residue cohomology vanishes outside $[a,b]$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] and in every degree has locally constant models [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] finite as modules over the exponent-one residue coefficient ring. No projective model or finite chart family is asserted.

proof.text: Take the common finite residue-cohomology interval. Choose the constructible stratification of every cohomology sheaf of both inputs in that interval and pull these finitely many partitions back to U. Use the existing constructible-cut helper to choose qc open neighborhoods and their complementary cuts. Iterate the binary pullback replacement over all strata, preserving earlier factorizations, and recursively forget ambient structural maps to obtain QcqsOpenClosedTree with each nonempty leaf factoring through a stratum of every partition.
Completeness on every qcqs weakly etale leaf object is the ordinary restriction theorem proved separately, with no ambient qcqs or invertibility assumption.

Use the existing finiteModels_of_lisse_stalks helper to obtain finite module models on every original residue stratum. Pull these models through the actual leaf factorization and use the constant-module pullback composition isomorphism. The ordinary integral reduction/homology comparison transfers both these models and the original cohomology bounds to the composite ordinary pullback. Outside the common interval use the zero model. Empty leaves impose no conditions.

lean.statement:
theorem affineResidueLisseTree
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (K L : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E X none)
    (hK : sfIntegralConstructible l E X K)
    (hL : sfIntegralConstructible l E X L)
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] :
    ∃ tree : QcqsOpenClosedTree U.toScheme,
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (p : tree.Path S), p.IsLeaf → Nonempty S →
        ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace V] [QuasiSeparatedSpace V]
          (r : V ⟶ S) [WeaklyEtale r]
          (M : IntegralOnSlice.D.{u, u} l E X none), M = K ∨ M = L →
          IntegralOnSlice.IsComplete l E V none
            ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ p.toRoot ≫ U.ι)).obj M) ∧
          ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E V 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ p.toRoot ≫ U.ι)).obj M)))) ∧
            (∀ q : ℤ, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafWithModelsOfUniverses V
              (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)
              (fun N ↦ Module.Finite (ULift.{u + 1}
                (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E 1)) N)
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E V 0).obj
                  ((ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull l E (r ≫ p.toRoot ≫ U.ι)).obj M))))
